_doc: Effects, transitions and text animations the build and the preview know. Generated from the research notes (FUSION_PLAN.md s2.5): source names the research note behind each row (a research reference: those notes do not ship with the skill). enabled false rows are refused by assemble with their refuse message; gate names the sandbox acceptance test that must pass for a P1 row to stay enabled. gate_result records what the sandbox test measured. stills_ok true: keyed effects on still images passed AT-A5 (a 1.0 to 1.1 push rendered 1.0, 1.05, 1.1).

cross_dissolve.source: fusion/transitions/notes.md s4 to s10 (catalog.json row cross_dissolve)
cross_dissolve.what: linear mix of A into B (frame k shows (k + 0.5)/d of B)
cross_dissolve.use_when: time passing, change of place, memory, a soft montage of related moments, slow emotional music, the end of a story beat
cross_dissolve.amateur_when: on every cut, to hide a jump cut in a talking head (reads as mush), 2-5 frames between unrelated shots (reads as a glitch), over a beat drop

preview.measured: [PRV] s3.3: 1.000 (correlation cannot see a dip: relative level)

dip_to_black.source: fusion/transitions/notes.md s4 to s10 (catalog.json row dip_to_black)
dip_to_black.what: A fades to black over the first half, B rises from black over the second (black is fixed by script)
dip_to_black.use_when: a chapter break, a jump in time, before the end card, a reset between unrelated ideas
dip_to_black.amateur_when: several in one short piece, between shots of one scene, at the very start of a reel (delays the hook)

additive_dissolve.source: fusion/transitions/notes.md s4 to s10 (catalog.json row additive_dissolve)
additive_dissolve.what: adds the two pictures, so the middle frames brighten strongly toward white
additive_dissolve.use_when: a bright, airy dissolve (light, summer, dreamy, wedding), a soft flash between bright shots
additive_dissolve.amateur_when: on dark or night footage (it clips highlights), on skin close-ups (burns out faces)

blur_dissolve.source: fusion/transitions/notes.md s4 to s10 (catalog.json row blur_dissolve)
blur_dissolve.what: a dissolve with both pictures softened through the middle
blur_dissolve.use_when: a dreamy or soft change between related shots (beauty, wedding, product), a softer alternative to a plain dissolve
blur_dissolve.amateur_when: in fast energetic cuts, on text-heavy frames (text smears)

non_additive_dissolve.source: fusion/transitions/notes.md s4 to s10 (catalog.json row non_additive_dissolve)
non_additive_dissolve.what: a contrasty ghosted mix that keeps the brighter of the two pictures, then B
non_additive_dissolve.use_when: a high-contrast ghosted mix (silhouettes, light sources over dark shots)
non_additive_dissolve.amateur_when: almost everywhere else: it darkens then jumps
non_additive_dissolve.refuse: non_additive_dissolve is a P2 transition (Non-Additive Dissolve): it reads as dated or amateur in reels; give the transition "look_is_brief": true when the brief asks for exactly this look

preview.measured: [PRV] s3.3: optical-flow morph, no ffmpeg match

smooth_cut.source: fusion/transitions/notes.md s4 to s10 (catalog.json row smooth_cut)
smooth_cut.what: an optical-flow morph from A to B, meant to hide a jump cut inside one shot
smooth_cut.use_when: hiding a small jump cut inside one talking-head shot (same framing, head in nearly the same place, a pause removed)
smooth_cut.amateur_when: between different shots, when the head moved or turned (faces warp), longer than about 6 frames
smooth_cut.gate: plan s6 question 8 (Smooth Cut on a real talking-head jump cut)
smooth_cut.only: inside one take: same media, source gap under 2 s
smooth_cut.gate_result: plan s6 question 8: clean on one 0.2 s jump inside a b-roll take; not yet seen on a talking-head jump cut (no such footage in the test labs)

custom_whip.source: fusion/transitions/notes.md s4 to s10 (catalog.json row custom_whip)
custom_whip.what: both pictures travel together on one eased offset (slow, fast, slow) with a 360-degree motion blur smear; A leaves and B arrives in the chosen direction, no mirror, no lens warp
custom_whip.use_when: a clean whip pan with no mirror or lens warp: two pictures on one eased offset with a 360-degree motion blur, any of 4 directions (all 4 rendered); the reel standard for energetic cuts
custom_whip.amateur_when: without a motivating camera move or on slow pieces; more than 2 or 3 per 15 s

custom_zoom_overlap.source: fusion/transitions/notes.md s4 to s10 (catalog.json row custom_zoom_overlap)
custom_zoom_overlap.what: A zooms in with an ease-in to `peak` over the first half, a short mix at the middle, B zooms out from `peak` to full frame with an ease-out; zoom blur from the Transforms' motion blur
custom_zoom_overlap.use_when: a zoom punch through the cut into a detail or a new place on a hit (sport, hype, food, fashion, travel) when both shots have handles; aim `point` at the subject
custom_zoom_overlap.amateur_when: on calm content; into an empty part of the frame; more than a few per piece; peak above about 3 (soft, pixelated)

preview.measured: [TR] s6 R2: 0.97 to 0.997 (perspective from the motion keys); sandbox pipeline run with the 360-degree motion blur on: the blurred middle frames 0.918 and 0.930 against the preview, so close (span median), not exact per frame

custom_zoom_through.source: fusion/transitions/notes.md s4 to s10 (catalog.json row custom_zoom_through)
custom_zoom_through.what: A zooms in over its last n frames and B zooms out over its first n frames (linear keys) with motion blur; a plain cut between, no overlap
custom_zoom_through.use_when: a zoom punch through the cut (sport, hype, food, fashion) when the shots have NO handles, since it needs no overlap
custom_zoom_through.amateur_when: on calm content; zooming into a face's edge; more than a few per piece
custom_zoom_through.gate_result: sandbox pipeline: placed as a clip pair on both items, keys read back; blurred frames 0.92 to 0.93 per frame, so the span median is checked

audio_xfade_plus3.source: fusion/transitions/notes.md s4 to s10 (catalog.json row audio_xfade_plus3)
audio_xfade_plus3.what: equal-power cross fade: gains sqrt(1-p) and sqrt(p), -3 dB each at the middle
audio_xfade_plus3.use_when: the default audio crossfade between different sounds (two music sections, room tones, ambiences): equal power keeps the loudness even
audio_xfade_plus3.amateur_when: between two pieces of the SAME continuous sound (it bumps up about 3 dB in the middle)

audio_xfade_0db.source: fusion/transitions/notes.md s4 to s10 (catalog.json row audio_xfade_0db)
audio_xfade_0db.what: linear cross fade: gains 1-p and p, -6 dB each at the middle
audio_xfade_0db.use_when: joining two pieces of the same sound (a split music clip, the skill's ducking pieces): linear sums flat
audio_xfade_0db.amateur_when: between unrelated sounds (dips in the middle)

audio_xfade_minus3.source: fusion/transitions/notes.md s4 to s10 (catalog.json row audio_xfade_minus3)
audio_xfade_minus3.what: a dipping cross fade: gains (1-p)^1.5 and p^1.5, -9 dB each at the middle
audio_xfade_minus3.use_when: a deliberate dip between two sounds
audio_xfade_minus3.refuse: audio_xfade_minus3 is not used by the build

preview.measured: motion table through perspective with an 8-sample shutter; one eased travel across both shots (fastest move across the cut, one key past the cut on each side so the motion blur never rests). Sandbox render (fix pass 2, t1 8-frame whip up): span median 0.976, min 0.844 against the preview at 36x64; Resolve's blur is smoother than the 8 samples, so close (span median), not exact

whip_pair.what: clip comps: the outgoing shot whips out over its last frames (accelerating), the incoming whips in from the other side (decelerating); a plain cut between, no handles needed
whip_pair.use_when: the whip when the shots have no handles
whip_pair.gate_result: fix pass 2: rendered in the sandbox; sharpness falls steadily into the cut and rises steadily out of it (0.62, 0.46, 0.27, 0.16 | 0.19, 0.29, 0.35, 0.35, 0.48, 0.81, 1.20; the shots at rest 0.7 and 1.3), no frame at rest in the middle (the first version keyed both apex frames one frame size away, which with wrap edges is the picture at rest)

punch.what: an eased zoom that stays (put it on the emphasis word)

bump.what: a beat pulse: quick up (out_quad) to the peak ON the beat, eased back (out_cubic)

snap.what: an impact zoom: level plus the overshoot on the hit, settling to the level, which stays

push.what: a slow push over the shot (2 to 6 s), in_out_sine
push.gate_result: integration build on a still end card: the push matched the preview at 0.9997 median against 0.88 for the card without it

shake.what: a seeded, decaying shake keyed per frame (Center through an XYPath, Angle), with the cover zoom zoom_to_hide asks for
shake.gate_result: AT-A2 passed: keyed path correlated 0.97 with the preview, fitted shift within 0.5 px

flash.what: a white flash peaking ON the event frame (BrightnessContrast Gain 1 - v, Brightness v)
flash.gate_result: AT-A8 passed: the flash frame's level rose 0.51 to 0.90

rgb_split.source: fusion/reel_effects/notes.md 4.8 rgb_split; fusion_api/notes.md s4 rgb_split (ChannelBooleans route)
rgb_split.what: red right and blue left by px of the width, alternating, last frame 0
rgb_split.gate_result: AT-A8 passed: 24 px measured for 12 px keyed on each side

glitch.what: a held RGB split jumping every 2 frames plus horizontal bands (seeded)
glitch.gate_result: integration build: the bands and the RGB split render on a real clip (correlation 0.92 to 0.95 against the clip without it on the glitch frames); the preview draws only the split, so the span is not pixel-checked

light_leak.what: a warm FastNoise leak screened over the picture, envelope keyed
light_leak.gate_result: integration build: the in-clip leak renders and raised the mean level by 22 of 255 (the preview by 21.7); its shape is approximate in the preview; fix pass 2: a leak anchored on cut_in now keeps its visible half (it was dropped): the render warms the shot's first frame by +27 red of 255 (the preview +36) and fades to 0 over 9 frames, as planned

ramp.what: a TimeStretcher speed ramp with SourceTime keyed on whole source frames

freeze.what: a held frame inside the item (flat SourceTime keys)

speed_warp.what: Speed Warp retime (RetimeProcess 3, MotionEstimation 5) on a constant slow speed
